retention.stated: An asset that you upload belongs to the user or group in the `creationContext` of your request, so it's available in Studio like any other asset that creator owns:
retention.notes: Managing asset versions, such as rolling back to a specified previous version.

egress.terms: Free. Asset delivery is served by Roblox's own CDN (assetdelivery.roblox.com / rbxcdn), never metered to the uploader.

tooling: Documented Open Cloud REST: POST https://apis.roblox.com/assets/v1/assets (multipart, x-api-key header), plus asset delivery API. API keys scoped to a user or group; no rclone.
chaining: 20 videos/day x 3.75 GB = 75 GB/day per ID-verified account = ~2.2 TB/month; unlimited accounts (each needing ID verification) and unlimited assets per account since there is no total quota. Non-video types: 20 MB x unlimited assets x 100-upload monthly audio cap.
limits_note: 20 MB/asset for models, images, decals, animation; video 3.75 GB but capped at 20/day and 5 min; audio hard-capped monthly; all uploads land in moderation; assets are permanently tied to a creator account.
reliability_note: Moderation removes assets silently and irreversibly; read-back needs an authenticated assetdelivery call (anonymous GET -> 401), so it is not a public cacheable fetch path.
confidence_note: the Open Cloud usage-assets guide states a 20 MB per-asset file-size limit
